idea: Run a cross-entropy-method search over size multisets. Keep a probability vector over how many squares of each side 1/d (d ≤ 3√n) to use. Decode each sampled multiset with a skyline placer on the lcm board, keep the top 10% of samples that pack with exactly n squares, and re-estimate the distribution. This is a smoother alternative to the GA, seeded at the Erdős–Soifer multiset.
